name: Sales
description:
Revenue and orders of the shop, refreshed when the board opens.
Totals in EUR, all channels, cancelled orders included.

query.sql:
select
  *
from
  demo.orders
order by
  total desc
limit
  100

select
  ordered,
  count(*) as orders
from
  demo.orders
group by
  1
order by
  1

tiles.title: Revenue per month
tiles.description: All orders, by the day they were placed.
tiles.sql:
select
  date_trunc('month', ordered)::date as month,
  sum(total) as revenue
from
  demo.orders
group by
  1
order by
  1

tiles.title: Revenue by category
tiles.sql:
select
  date_trunc('quarter', ordered)::date as quarter,
  sum(total) filter (where category = 'Electronics') as "Electronics",
  sum(total) filter (where category = 'Home') as "Home",
  sum(total) filter (where category = 'Fashion') as "Fashion",
  sum(total) filter (where category = 'Sports') as "Sports",
  sum(total) filter (where category = 'Books') as "Books"
from
  demo.orders
group by
  1
order by
  1

tiles.title: Countries
tiles.sql:
select
  c.name as country,
  count(*) as orders,
  sum(o.total) as revenue,
  round(avg(o.total), 2) as avg_order
from
  demo.orders o
  join demo.countries c on c.code = o.country
group by
  1
order by
  revenue desc
